_comment: Source of truth for the 'Supported inverters' section in README.md. Edit this file, then run scripts/render_readme.py.

inverters.connection: Modbus TCP over LAN, via the FoxESS Modbus integration
inverters.notes: Maintainer's system. All features, including the PV-curtailment flag (register 49251) used to send otherwise throttled solar to the car.

inverters.connection: Modbus TCP over LAN, via the FoxESS Modbus integration
inverters.notes: Same platform as the tested H3-10.0-Smart; the sizes differ in power rating only.

inverters.model: H1 (incl. AC1, AIO-H1, G2), H3 (incl. AC3, AIO-H3), H3 Pro, P1, KH
inverters.connection: Modbus TCP or RS485, via the FoxESS Modbus integration with write access
inverters.notes: Expected to work when the integration exposes work mode, force charge / discharge power and min SoC. The PV-curtailment flag is read from an H3 register and may be unavailable on other models. Reports welcome as GitHub issues.

inverters.model: Kuara H3, Sonnenkraft SK-HWR, STAR, Solavita SP, a-TroniX AX
inverters.connection: Via the FoxESS Modbus integration with write access
inverters.notes: Listed as supported by the FoxESS Modbus integration. Same conditions as the FoxESS row above.

inverters.model: MIN TL-XH, MOD TL3-XH, MID TL3-XH (GEN4 hybrid)
inverters.connection: ShineWLAN-X2 (Modbus TCP, port 502) or RS485-to-TCP adapter, via the SolaX Inverter Modbus integration
inverters.firmware: Must support VPP remote power control (registers 30407-30410); versions not yet confirmed
inverters.notes: Not available yet. Scope, dependencies and design: [docs/GROWATT.md](docs/GROWATT.md).

inverters.model: SPH, SPA (GEN3), MIC, MIN TL-X, MOD TL3-X, MID TL3-X, SPF, WIT
inverters.notes: Older generation, no battery, off-grid or commercial models. Only GEN4 hybrids with VPP remote power control are in scope.
Battery control is written for FoxESS, with Growatt GEN4 hybrids planned.
